mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is a clear 57 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon. We have an overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to review several development items, including the Ardent Glen addition and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way. Also, keep in mind that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Throughout the week, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory. Plus, mark your calendars for the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating the incident.
Today's flavor of the day was Snickers Swirl. As the store is now closed for the night, we look forward to serving you again tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM with our next flavor, Pumpkin Pecan.
